items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution. Adobe published an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026, for this vulnerability, which is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE and Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Discovered in August 2025, SessionReaper is a critical flaw (CVSS 9.1) in all versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento that allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks were observed globally starting October 22, 2025.
